# HeyDiff brand guide v4

> Brand identity and product design system for HeyDiff, team feedback for software built with AI. Version 4, 30 Oct 2026, owner Calvin Dudek. Logo: mark A (two speech bubbles with one square corner each, coral left, blue right, violet overlap) beside the lower-case wordmark heydiff, lockup 5:4. Product accent Decision Violet #6E4EF0, Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono, controls 32/40/48, pill buttons, Graphite dark mode.

Each page has a Markdown file with its text and a PNG of the screen; read both. The canvas is the source; heydiff-kit holds the tokens in code; logo files are in heydiff-context/brand/v4.

## Start here

- [Implementation brief](implementation-brief.md): what to build in heydiff-kit, heydiff-web, heydiff-chrome and heydiff-mac, in order
- [Decisions](decisions.md): every rule in one line, with the page to read
- [Full guide as Markdown](brand-guide.md): all pages in page order
- [Tokens](tokens/tokens.json): colour, status, brand, type, control and radius tokens, light and dark
- [Manifest](manifest.json): index of pages and files
- [PDF](heydiff-brand-guide-v4.pdf): the whole guide, bookmarked
- [Overview](overview.png): all pages as thumbnails
